metadata.question: Does forest cover in Petén, Guatemala decrease in 2023 compared to 2001?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Petén, Guatemala (need to define geometry for this region) - Time periods: 2001 vs 2023 - Collection: Hansen Global Forest Change dataset is ideal for forest cover analysis, or MODIS Land Cover - Hansen provides forest loss/gain data with 2000 as baseline 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for Hansen dataset (it's already processed) - Focus on forest cover comparison between the two years 3. Logic: - Calculate forest area in 2001 and 2023 - Valid Zero: If forest area is legitimately 0 or decreased (Answer B if increased/same, A if decreased) - C1: If no data available for the region - C2: If valid pixels = 0 after processing - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Define Petén, Guatemala geometry const peten = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-92.0, 16.0, -89.0, 18.0]); // Approximate bounds for Petén // 2. Use Hansen Global Forest Change dataset const hansen = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_11'); // 3. Get forest cover baseline (year 2000) and loss/gain through 2023 const treecover2000 = hansen.select('treecover2000'); // Tree cover in year 2000 const loss = hansen.select('loss'); // Forest loss (2000-2023) const lossyear = hansen.select('lossyear'); // Year of loss const gain = hansen.select('gain'); // Forest gain (2000-2012) // 4. Calculate forest cover for 2001 (approximately same as 2000 baseline) // Consider pixels with >30% tree cover as forest const forest2000 = treecover2000.gte(30); // 5. Calculate forest cover for 2023 // Loss by 2001 (lossyear = 1 means loss in 2001) const lossBy2001 = lossyear.lte(1).and(loss.eq(1)); const forest2001 = forest2000.and(lossBy2001.not()); // Loss by 2023 (lossyear <= 23) const lossBy2023 = lossyear.lte(23).and(loss.eq(1)); const forest2023 = forest2000.and(lossBy2023.not()).or(gain.eq(1)); // 6. Calculate areas const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); const area2001 = forest2001.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: peten, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area2023 = forest2023.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: peten, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Count valid pixels const count2001 = forest2001.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: peten, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count2023 = forest2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: peten, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area2001Val = area2001.get('treecover2000').getInfo(); const area2023Val = area2023.get('treecover2000').getInfo(); const pixels2001 = count2001.get('treecover2000').getInfo(); const pixels2023 = count2023.get('treecover2000').getInfo(); // 7. Validation if (pixels2001 === 0 || pixels2023 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels found'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (area2001Val === null || area2023Val === null || isNaN(area2001Val) || isNaN(area2023Val)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert to km² const forest2001_km2 = area2001Val / 1e6; const forest2023_km2 = area2023Val / 1e6; const change = forest2023_km2 - forest2001_km2; const changePercent = (change / forest2001_km2) * 100; // 8. Print results console.log(`Forest 2001: ${forest2001_km2.toFixed(2)} km² (Pixels: ${pixels2001})`); console.log(`Forest 2023: ${forest2023_km2.toFixed(2)} km² (Pixels: ${pixels2023})`); console.log(`Change: ${change.toFixed(2)} km² (${changePercent.toFixed(2)}%)`); // 9. Final answer if (forest2023_km2 < forest2001_km2) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (error) { console.log('Error:', error.message); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
